title: Supported Cartier Kummer map for ordinary etale arbitrary finite coefficients
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $N\geq1$ be invertible on $T$, and let $A$ be a finite commutative ring with $NA=0$. Let $i:D\hookrightarrow T$ be an effective Cartier divisor: its ideal is locally generated by one non-zero-divisor [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal], and let $j:T\setminus D\hookrightarrow T$ be its open complement. Use the ordinary small etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and the twist $A_T(1)=\mu_{N,T}\otimes_{(\mathbf Z/N)_T}A_T$ of [lem-asd-finite-etale-twist-line]. The line bundle $\mathcal O_T(D)$ [def-pc-divisor-line-bundle] with its canonical trivialization off $D$ has a supported Kummer boundary for the exact sequence of [lem-amb-kummer-any-base]. This boundary determines a canonical morphism
$$c_{D,A}:Ri_*A_D\longrightarrow A_T(1)[2].$$
If $u_D:A_T\longrightarrow Ri_*A_D$ is the inverse-image/direct-image unit, then $c_{D,A}u_D=c_1(\mathcal O_T(D))$, where $c_1$ is the Kummer boundary followed by derived scalar extension from $\mathbf Z/N$ to $A$. For every morphism $v:T'\to T$ whose scheme-theoretic pullback $D'=T'\times_TD$ remains an effective Cartier divisor, the canonical closed-immersion exchange identifies $v^{-1}c_{D,A}$ with $c_{D',A}$. The map is the derived scalar extension of $c_{D,\mathbf Z/N}$, using the canonical identifications of its source and target with $Ri_*A_D$ and $A_T(1)[2]$.

proof.text: Choose the unique normalized boundary κ by [lem-asd-cartier-boundary-existence]. Choose normalized roots and line transport t from [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback], taking degree one of its tensor comparisons.

Set c to the exact derived realization of κ and c₁ to Ext.homEquiv.symm of the derived unit composed with c. Their realization equality is Ext.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply. The Chern clause follows from [lem-asd-supported-kummer-chern-realization].

For every Cartier pullback choose its unique normalized κ′. Finite sheaf base change makes baseChangeMap invertible; composing with the constant inverse-image isomorphism proves invertibility of supportedConstantExchange. Apply [lem-asd-supported-kummer-boundary-pullback] for the Ext equation.

For coefficients ULift(Z/N), choose the unique normalized κ₀ by boundary existence. Apply [lem-asd-supported-kummer-boundary-scalar] to κ₀ and κ. Assemble all existential witnesses and conjunctions. The uniqueBoundary declaration continues to use boundary existence directly.
